## Owlephant (CR 8)

**XP** 4,800  
 N Huge magical beast  
 Init—1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +18  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 16, touch 7, flat-footed 16 (–1 Dex, +9 natural, –2 size)  
 **hp** 150 (10d10+50)  
 **Fort** +13; **Ref** +6; **Will** +6  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 25 ft.  
 **Melee** slam +11 (2d6+2), 2 talons +10 (1d8+2), gore +10 (2d8+3)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** trample (2d8+3, DC 17)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 14, **Dex** 9, **Con** 19, **Int** 5, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +14; **CMD** 23 (27 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Great Fortitude, Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception) B, Weapon FinesseB, [Weapon Focus (slam)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Endurance is part of Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (slam).*  
 **Skills** Perception +18, Stealth +1; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +4 Stealth  
 
   


**Ecology**

 
 **Environment** warm forests  
 **Organization** solitary or pair  
 **Treasure** none
